newsitem.title: USA: Unitil Corp names Charles Tenney interim CEO.
newsitem.headline: Unitil Corp names Charles Tenney interim CEO.

text.p: Unitil Corp said Thursday it has named Charles Tenney interim chief executive officer while the board searches for a permanent successor to Peter Stulgis, who died May 18.
Stulgis had been chairman and chief executive officer.
The company said Michael Dalton will remain president and chief operating officer, and Gail Siart will remain chief financial officer.
The company said Tenney has been chairman of the company's executive committee and is a former company chief executive officer.
The company said Tenney, Dalton and Siart will collaborate to temporarily handle duties of board chairman.
